metadata.title: Córdoba Basin Explorer
metadata.description: Satellite explorer of the basins of Córdoba, Argentina: the Primero, Segundo, Tercero, Cuarto and Quinto rivers, Mar Chiquita and their streams.

maplibre.title: Map of the basins of Córdoba

examples.0: Which is longer, Primero or Segundo?

attributions.metaTitle: Sources and licenses · Córdoba Basin Explorer

modeled.regulated: Dams regulate several of these rivers today (Embalse Río III, Los Molinos, San Roque, Cerro Pelado, Cruz del Eje and others), so their flow can differ a lot from the natural averages shown here.

landing.h1: Follow the water from the Sierras to Mar Chiquita and the Paraná.
landing.sub: Explore the rivers of Córdoba, from the Primero and Segundo to the Tercero, Cuarto and Quinto, their streams and basins on satellite imagery.
landing.f2p: Switch from the whole region to its six basins, then drill into sub-basins and water management units with breadcrumb navigation.
landing.d2: Discharge is a modeled natural average for 1971–2000 and does not reflect current regulation by dams such as Embalse Río III, Los Molinos, San Roque and Cerro Pelado. Population is a 2010 estimate.

card.alt: Satellite image of the basins of Córdoba with their rivers highlighted in cyan

stream.nameNote: Name from APRHI inside Córdoba, from IGN outside it. The stream joins the reaches that share this name along the flow network.
